PRELAP TO: 

EXT. WILDERNESS

PLAYER GOES TO LILITH STATUE. ROSES ARE GROWING OVER IT. THEY TAKE SOME OF THE PETALS.

CUT TO: PLAYER IS ON A BOAT.

THEY DROP THE ROSE PETALS INTO THE WATER.
CAMERA PANS UP TO REVEAL: THE CITY OF TEMIS LOOMING AHEAD. THE PLAYER IS HEADING THERE. THEY HAVE LEFT THE PAST BEHIND -- NOW THEY MOVE INTO THE FUTURE.
